title: A checkpoint is a kind of phase where the agent proves its work
reference: Trevor, 2026-11-05: "I think it's a kind of phase maybe? Like you can have a few phases in between followed by a checkpoint?" On estimating size: "Number of things I guess? I mean how do we do estimation in software engineering before we know anything?" On what is surprising: "Use your judgement." On merging: "Once approved the AI should merge. It really is just a place where the AI can take a breath and prove the work it did works. It's at the discretion of the user if each checkpoint necessitates a PR with their colleagues."
